lines: Good morning, Leonida! You're locked in to Map FM.
The only station that knows where you parked.
From the Keys all the way up to Vice City.
Zoom in close enough to see your ex's driveway. Not that we would.
Gas, guns, clubs, burgers. Everything a growing family needs.
Hit the legend, hide the rest. We don't judge.
Just type it in. The map takes you right there. Unlike your cousin.
Leonida speaks your language. Mostly the bad words.
Found a hidden ride? An easter egg?
Right click, add it. It's open source, honey. Free, like the samples at the mall.
Link's in the post. Drive safe. Or don't.
